visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with medium-length brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt, stands in a room with a white wall and a white cabinet. He is looking at his phone with a focused expression. (2) The man is shown placing two bottles of water on a white shelf within a cabinet; the bottles have distinctive red caps and labels featuring a temple logo. (3) Seated at a table, the man holds a brown paper bag and removes a bottle of water, while a wine glass sits empty on the table. (4) The man holds the water bottle up, pointing at it enthusiastically as red radial lines and sparkle graphics appear behind him to emphasize the object. (5) In a series of close-ups, the man continues to speak while gesturing with his hands; cartoon graphics of baby bottles and shimmering stars float around him. (6) The man unscrews the red cap of the bottle while holding another bottle in his other hand, with vibrant yellow and red graphic splashes filling the background. (7) The man pours the clear water from the bottle into a tall, clear wine glass. (8) He reacts with a shocked facial expression as cartoon icons of sweat drops and waste appear above him; he then transfers the water into a plastic spray bottle. (9) A woman wearing a grey sweatshirt and a white baseball cap appears, looking curiously at the wine glass before taking a drink from it while heart emojis appear. (10) A pink closet door opens to reveal several banknotes falling to the floor, accompanied by golden sparkle overlays. (11) A young girl in a purple fuzzy sweater holds the spray bottle, looks surprised, and then sprays it into the air as graphics of gold coins and red envelopes appear. (12) The man is shown in a black-and-white shot with a broken heart emoji, looking distressed; he then pours a whole bottle of water over his head while gold coins rain down. (13) A small boy dressed as the God of Wealth in a red traditional robe and hat appears, laughing and holding a large gold ingot. (14) The man holds up three fingers while a scroll-like graphic displays a list of information. (15) The man holds the boy while pointing at various text overlays about a promotional event, dates, and prizes, eventually ending with a traditional greeting gesture.
